title: Unkey Rate Limit Result
description: Result of a rate limit check from the Unkey platform, indicating whether the request is allowed and the current window state.

success.description: Whether this request was allowed (true) or denied due to rate limit exceeded (false)

limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the window

remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current window

reset.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the current window resets
